title: Having a blast in Godot
author: Wheelydope
selftext:
Hi everyone. I just wanted to share a project I started about 6 weeks ago. This game has been a pipe dream between my brother and I for years. 

Rainbow Lakes is an adventure/park sim style game where you are the caretaker of a private piece of land in the Colorado mountains. The goal is to maintain the property, take care of the residents, learn about the history of the park, protect the ecosystem, and enjoy the scenic views. 

This is my first attempt at making a video game and I’ve been working on it diligently for about 6 weeks. So far, I built this with Godot 4.7, Blender, MeshyAI, Synty Packs, Suno, and Codex. 

Let me know your thoughts! I’ve been super inspired by this new found ability to make video games thanks to AI. [https://youtu.be/HAYR-6m-Rls?is=UQxm-NVsYhiKRoE3](https://youtu.be/HAYR-6m-Rls?is=UQxm-NVsYhiKRoE3)
